title: Phase 3: Data Surfaces Implementation Plan
summary: Phase 3 UI/UX rework plan: turn admin data surfaces into token-native reading surfaces (masthead-aware charts, KPI tiles, ledger tables, audit timeline, global analytics) reusing the Phase 0/2 design system.
notes: Strong SPEC signals: tech stack declaration, per-file change lists, consumed/produced interface contracts with type signatures, code snippets, verification gates, and hard constraints. No ADR markers (no Decision/Consequences/Status) and no PRD markers (no user stories). It is a task-oriented implementation plan (checkbox steps for agentic workers) referencing an external spec's sections (§6.1-§6.6) rather than a standalone contract doc, hence medium confidence.
